english.note: Use this before an adjective or description when something begins to have a new quality or condition.
Use this when get means enter or bring oneself into a new state or condition.

examples.jyutping: tin1 hei3 bin3 dak1 loeng4 faai3 zo2

examples.english: I get really lazy when the weather turns cold.
examples.traditional: 天氣一凍，我就變得好懶。
examples.jyutping: tin1 hei3 jat1 dung3 ngo5 zau6 bin3 dak1 hou2 laan5
